name: Long-form freebie
description: Dense opt-in pitch page. Hero, proof, why-this-exists, outcomes, a long testimonial stack and a closing invite.
intent: Long-form freebie opt-in page. For a value-led lead magnet where the reader needs to be walked from problem recognition through the why, the outcomes, and real member proof before they drop their email. Warm, grounded, never pushy.

name: Long-form freebie · variant
description: Alternative arrangement with the opt-in embedded in the hero and a feature grid leading the proof.
intent: Long-form freebie opt-in, same bones as the first but re-sequenced. Email capture lives in the hero. Feature grid leads the structural proof before the narrative 'why' lands.

name: Interactive freebie
description: Inline-form landing. Not actually interactive, but it reads tighter with a curriculum preview and a single pull-quote of proof.
intent: Short landing for a freebie, inline email capture. Reader should finish the page in under 30 seconds. One 3-item curriculum preview, one confident pull quote, one clean opt-in.

name: Medium freebie · colourful
description: Mid-length landing with more visual pop. Leads with outcomes, backs it with a curriculum preview and duo of testimonials.
intent: Mid-length freebie opt-in with visual lift. Outcomes first, curriculum tease second, two short testimonials, warm closing opt-in. Use this when the freebie needs more persuasion than a simple page but less than a full long-form pitch.

name: Medium freebie · neutral
description: Mid-length landing in Tracy's muted palette. Opt-in hero, editorial why, curriculum preview, closing card opt-in.
intent: Mid-length neutral freebie opt-in. Calm, grounded palette, editorial rhythm. Reader lands in the form quickly, is reassured through the why and curriculum, then closes with a quiet second opt-in.

name: Simple freebie
description: Minimal opt-in page. Hero, one reassurance beat, one opt-in, footer. Nothing else.
intent: Minimal freebie opt-in. Use when the freebie is already well-known to the audience, or when paid traffic lands warm and just needs a frictionless 'give me my file' moment.

name: Download / Thank-you page
description: Warm delivery page for post-opt-in arrival. Results hero, what's next, a soft invitation, footer.
intent: Thank-you page that opens after someone submits an opt-in. Celebratory but quiet. Tells them what to do next and offers one soft secondary path.

name: Download / TY · variant
description: Alt TY layout with a navigation bar, results hero, structured next-steps, and a softer upsell before the footer.
intent: Thank-you page variant with a tiny top nav and more scaffolding. Use when the reader may need to pin the page or navigate back to the rest of the site.

name: Upsell · OTO
description: One-time-offer page. OTO hero, dark why, offer stack, guarantee, single testimonial, single-CTA close.
intent: Post-opt-in one-time offer page. Direct, confident, skips fake scarcity. Hero states the offer and price, the why block reframes the problem, offer stack lists what's included, guarantee removes risk, one testimonial provides proof, footer closes.

name: Bonus-heavy offer interrupter
description: Bonus-heavy mid-page offer interrupter style. Loud OTO framing with stacked offers and proof.
intent: OTO page built as a mid-funnel interrupter. Higher energy than the standard OTO, more stacked bonuses up front. Use when traffic is warm and the reader needs a loud reason to stop scrolling.

name: FFB sales page
description: Sales page for Freedom Filled® Business Mentorship. Stage-portrait hero, editorial callout, marquee proof, quiet FAQ.
intent: Sales page for FFB Mentorship. Warm, confident, invitation not pitch, for women who've done other programs and are ready for the mentorship that actually sticks. Uses Tracy's signature aesthetic end-to-end.
